earlier_scan.source_named: Akau, Kambai Tabari L. 2014. The Tyap-English Dictionary (phonology intro pp. xxiv-xxix); also Follingstad 1991 Aspects of Tyap Syntax (UT Arlington MA thesis). Neither online; Tyap is tonal.

sources.citation: Bungwon, Akila Dutse & Kambai Akau. [2026]. A Guide to Learn How to Read and Write Tyap: a short transition literacy course for beginners. Tyap Wikimedians User Group & Tyap Language Development Board. 50 pp. (Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0)

sources.note: Nothing on stress. Sec. 4.3 'Tonal Marking' (pp.34-35): tone diacritics high/low/mid(unmarked)/rising/falling; minimal pairs zon 'goat' vs zón 'goats', a̱ 'he/she' vs á̱ 'they'; 'In Tyap, the Low Tone is the most frequent, and therefore is usually not indicated.'
